Merge the first reviewed pull request

## Goal

Prove the team's workflow works before Sprint 1 starts. It can be small, such as the README update.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The pull request comes from a `feature/*` branch into `develop`.
- [ ] A teammate who did not write it reviews and approves it.
- [ ] The pull request is merged.
- [ ] Its description includes `Closes #` and the issue number, so the issue closes when it merges.

## Where to look

Canvas: [Team] GitHub Repository & Project Board Setup and the Git page.
